notes.title: Patch 1.3 - Collider improvement
notes.content:
[b]We would like to report some improvements that were made in version 1.3:[/b]
[olist]
[*] [b]We improved the game's collider system, now it's easier to choose tiles that are partially hidden by some piece[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed lighting bug[/b]
[/olist]

notes.title: Chess Dungeons is officially launched
notes.content:
[h1]Chess Dungeons is officially launched[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42473881/24b545dbc923fa531949dd2923c2fda60b4325dc.png[/img]

[h2]Help the white pieces escape by solving chess puzzles ranging from beginner-level to more experienced challenges in this dungeon-themed sokoban-style game.[/h2]
[h3]With two game modes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Your goal is to slay the enemy's King. While other pieces can (and sometimes should!) be targeted, your main focus is to eliminate the King.
[*] A harder challenge! Don't just target the enemy King. Wipe out all of the black pieces!
[/list]

[h3]I would like to thank the entire community, the playtesters without you the game would not be possible.[/h3]
